bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 31-March-2020 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2019 (audited). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself. Total assets (80,960,162,109), total liabilities (72,277,752,269) and total equity (8,682,409,841, confirmed both by total_assets-minus-total_liabilities -- to within Tk.1 -- and by summing the five reported equity components, which agree exactly) all reconcile; this quarter's balance-sheet format relabels the last equity line 'Surplus in profit and loss account' (replacing 'Retained earnings') while keeping a separate 'Current year's profit' line, unchanged in substance. Paid-up capital unchanged at 6,224,050,160. Dec-2019 comparative equity (8,420,962,311) independently reconciles via component sum, providing an external cross-check on this bank's own 2019_Q4.json record. Printed 'Earning per share (Annualized)' of 1.44 is PAT (224,556,600)/shares (622,405,016) x4 = 1.4429, rounding to 1.44; eps_cumulative below is back-derived (1.44/4=0.36). BAS-33 EPS RESTATEMENT MECHANISM OBSERVED WITHIN A QUARTERLY FILING (not just annual reports, where this dataset has documented it extensively): this filing's own Q1-2019 comparative EPS is printed as 0.87, NOT the 0.9611 that Q1-2019's own filing (2019_Q1.json) reported -- because this filing recalculates the Q1-2019 comparative using the CURRENT (31-Mar-2020) share count of 622,405,016 rather than Q1-2019's own contemporaneous share count of 565,822,742 (135,955,982/622,405,016 x4 = 0.8739, rounding to 0.87, vs 135,955,982/565,822,742 x4 = 0.9611); the underlying PAT, assets, deposits and loans are identical in both. This dataset's own 2019_Q1.json keeps that quarter's first-published EPS, per the project's standing convention. No classified-loans/NPL, provision, capital-adequacy or NAV-per-share disclosure in this filing -- recorded as a gap.
